description: Use this when the user asks whether AI tools can read a business's details from its website. It reports whether the business name, phone number, email, address, opening hours and prices are readable as text in the page, only appear after scripts run, or weren't found, on the homepage and up to 2 contact, booking or pricing pages that robots.txt allows. Input: one public website. Reads robots.txt, the homepage, /llms.txt, /.well-known/search and up to 2 more pages as PreferlyBot; changes nothing.

website.description: The public website to check, like example.com or https://www.example.com. One site per call.

name: check_business_info
title: Check readable business info
